timestamp_basis: Recording time after the structured response, not a separately captured click timestamp.
owner_instruction: After you feel confident in everything that is done, please deploy it via ~/docker-lander's docker compose stack for testing by me the owner on my Mac.

owner_choices.deployment_stage_label: After the M1 browser candidate is playable, before my acceptance testing (recommended)
owner_choices.mac_access_label: Localhost through an SSH tunnel (secure-context support, no public exposure)
owner_choices.https_origin_response: No need, just localhost for now

approved_scope: Deploy the playable M1 owner-testing candidate into the existing home-services Compose stack, using localhost-only access forwarded to the owner's Mac through SSH. Do not deploy the currently fenced engineering preview.
conditions: First establish and record that the exact candidate supports normal playable browser entry and the required M1 interactions without diagnostic-camera or fixture fallbacks.
Do not require prior owner Mac acceptance or final Mac performance evidence to deploy for those very checks; deployment readiness and milestone acceptance are separate gates.
Add or update only ClubScape-owned services and resources. Preserve unrelated stack configuration, containers and persistent data; never restart or tear down the whole stack for this task.
Publish the application only on host loopback and provide the matching Mac SSH-forward command and localhost URL when deployed. No public hostname, TLS setup or browser security bypass is requested.

Use isolated owner-testing persistence and supported normal account creation. Never copy private saved checkpoints, credentials, session archives or development control directories into the deployment or image.
Record the deployed revision/image identities, actual service readiness and browser handoff without claiming M1 acceptance or a release.
